# Coordinated finish: draft PR

Using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work: coordinated finish, three members. Membership comes from `## Legs` in `doc/specs/shared.md`. The recorded contracts are authoritative.

**Choice: Option 2, push and create a draft Pull Request.** I apply it to the companions in declared order (repo-b, then repo-c), then to home (repo-a). Every worktree and branch is preserved. Draft has no cleanup.

## 1. Validate receipts and freshness

- **Receipts:** I checked the directory `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/`. It is empty, so no leg is receipt-proven and no leg is skipped.
- **Freshness:** Before each delivery I compare each leg's audited head and tree with its current checkout, including staged, unstaged and untracked state.
  - All three match the audited clean heads.
  - No re-verification or re-review is needed.
  - Each leg's `node --test test/parser.test.mjs` passed fresh in its own worktree.
  - Conformance passed against Rules `AGENTS.md` and the owned rows: AC 1 for repo-a and repo-b, AC 2 for repo-c.

## 2. Deliver the companions (no plan strip, no telemetry seal)

**repo-b** (worktree from the brief, primary `/work/repo-b`):
```bash
git -C <repo-b worktree> push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd <repo-b worktree> && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "<repo-b PR body style>
Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md")
```
- The draft PR was created at https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2.
- I wrote the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-b`:
  ```text
  attempted-head: <full repo-b feature SHA>
  delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 <full repo-b feature SHA>
  verification: passed
  ```

**repo-c** (worktree `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`):
```bash
git -C /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "<repo-c PR body style>
Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md")
```
- The draft PR was created at https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3.
- I wrote the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-c` in the same shape, with `delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3 <full repo-c feature SHA>` and `verification: passed`.

I wrote no `.pi/gauntlet/telemetry/` file in any companion.

## 3. Home strip and seal (both companion results collected)

- Before the strip I captured the spec path `doc/specs/shared.md`, the recorded verification set and the accepted task evidence.
- On `/work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change` I stripped the plan:
  - The basename task plan and `<sibling plans dir>/shared-ledger.md` were each removed if tracked.
  - The spec and the telemetry record were kept.

The seal ran with one `--leg` per companion:
```bash
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change \
  --option pr --base <base-branch> --spec doc/specs/shared.md \
  --leg repo-b=https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 \
  --leg repo-c=https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
```
- The seal exited 0.
- Its stdout was not supplied, so I can't quote it here. In a real run it would be printed verbatim here, as a `sealed …` line or another reported outcome.
- There was no prior seal, so there is no stored `legs:` set to reconcile. No second seal runs.

## 4. Deliver home

```bash
git -C /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "## Summary
<2-3 bullets>

## Test Plan
- [ ] node --test test/parser.test.mjs (each leg)

## Companion PRs
- repo-b: https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
- repo-c: https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3")
```
- The draft PR was created at https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1.
- I wrote the home receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-a` with `delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1 <full repo-a feature SHA>` and `verification: passed`.

## Result

```text
Shipped: repo-b https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
Shipped: repo-c https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
Shipped: repo-a https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1
Not shipped: none
```

Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed. Draft needs no cleanup, so the receipts were removed right after the home PR landed.

**Retained, nothing removed:**
- **repo-a:** worktree `/work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`, branch `feature/shared-change`
- **repo-b:** worktree as recorded in the brief, branch `feature/shared-change`
- **repo-c:** worktree `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`, branch `feature/shared-change`

```
phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })
```

Once the merges and any deploy land, run `/skill:check-delivery <ticket-ref>` to prove delivery before the ticket advances.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
### Draft PR delivery

Deliver companions in declared order, then home. All PR creation commands include `--draft`.

1. **repo-b**
   - Push `feature/shared-change` from `/work/repo-b/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`.
   - Create the draft PR with this line in its body:
     `Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md`
   - Created: https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
   - Write its home-owned receipt with the full attempted feature SHA, URL, full delivered PR head, and `verification: passed`.

2. **repo-c**
   - Push `feature/shared-change` from `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`.
   - Create the draft PR with the same `Home:` line.
   - Created: https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
   - Write its receipt with the corresponding full SHAs, URL, and `verification: passed`.

3. **Home strip and seal**
   - Retain the selected spec, recorded verification commands, accepted task evidence, and receipt locations before stripping the home plan.
   - Strip only the ephemeral home plan; preserve the spec and telemetry.
   - Run the home seal once with `--option pr`, the resolved base, `--spec doc/specs/shared.md`, and:
     ```text
     --leg repo-b=https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
     --leg repo-c=https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
     ```
   - No companion plan stripping or telemetry sealing runs.
   - **Stop here if sealing fails:** print its actual output, preserve both delivered drafts and their receipts, and do not deliver home. No seal result was supplied, so successful sealing cannot be asserted.

### After a successful seal

Push home and create its draft PR, listing both companion URLs in its body. The supplied home delivery result is:

https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1

Write home’s receipt. Preserve **every worktree and branch**; do not invoke destroy commands, the teardown hook, built-in removal, pruning, or branch deletion.

The successful completion report is:

```text
Shipped: repo-a https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1
Shipped: repo-b https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
Shipped: repo-c https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3

Worktrees preserved:
repo-a /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change
repo-b /work/repo-b/.worktrees/feature-shared-change
repo-c /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change

Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed
```

Include the seal’s actual stdout verbatim in that completion report, then mark the ship phase complete. No cleanup is required for draft PR delivery.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Both facts hold in After as in Before: companions are pushed/created repo-b then repo-c then home with --draft inside each leg's own cwd, every worktree and branch is listed as retained, and only home strips and seals once with both --leg values while section 2 explicitly states no companion plan strip and no companion telemetry file. Two drifts are worth watching even though they did not move a fact here: After relocates the receipt directory from the home worktree's `.pi/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/` (with the info/exclude step) to `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/`, which is still home-owned but is the primary's gitdir rather than the home checkout, and it drops the untracked-exclusion step; keep the recorded `.pi/gauntlet/receipts/` path under the home worktree so receipt-validated retries resolve the same location. After also says the seal stdout 'was not supplied' rather than printing a verbatim placeholder as Before did; wording like 'print the bin's stdout verbatim' keeps the seal-output contract stable while still delivering the per-leg seal narration.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves `order` to holds by naming each push/create's own checkout (`from /work/repo-b/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`, `from /work/repo-c/...`) alongside the repo-b → repo-c → home sequence, `--draft` on every create, the explicit 'Preserve every worktree and branch' list, and the home-owned receipts; Before had the sequence, --draft, preservation and receipts but never stated the cwd for any push/create, so a reader could not confirm the per-leg cwd clause. `seal` holds in both: each runs one home seal after both companion results with both `--leg` values and rules out companion plan stripping and telemetry sealing. Keep the After wording as is; if trimming, retain the per-leg `from <worktree path>` phrasing on the push/create steps and the 'Run the home seal once with ... --leg ... --leg ...' line, since those are what carry `order` and `seal` respectively. One small tightening: say the repo-c receipt is also home-owned explicitly rather than relying on repo-b's wording.
